name: Indian Financial Fraud Dataset
description: Comprehensive dataset of financial fraud cases in India. Contains transaction patterns, fraud indicators, and customer data for fraud detection analysis.

name: Gurugram Hospital Analytics Dataset
description: Comprehensive synthetic hospital dataset with 40,000+ patients, 80 doctors, and 4,00,000+ billing transactions. Contains OPD/IPD patient records, disease-doctor mapping, treatment costs, and detailed transaction data for healthcare analytics and dashboard building.

name: E-commerce Analytics Dataset
description: Comprehensive synthetic e-commerce dataset with 40,000+ customers, 2,000+ products, and 2,50,000+ transactions. Contains customer demographics, product details, transaction history, and sales data for e-commerce analytics and dashboard building.
